contradiction_discovered: The frozen §10 row routed EXECUTED + INDETERMINATE to 'PLAN or INTEGRATION, by reason'. The same observation, INDETERMINATE(PRECONDITION_ABSENT), means different things at different measurement points: at the parent it is the expected pre-state of an INTRODUCE obligation; at the candidate it is the admitted implementation's failure to establish the subject. The frozen row cannot express DEVELOPER at all, so a correct implementation could not conform.
